title: Probe Harmonizer: correlate token throughput drift, latency, and error patterns for VPC fleets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: private (VPC) deployments expose subtle failure modes where token throughput drops or 'leaks' are visible only when correlating latency, error rates, and per-node token counters. Current probes are siloed (latency-only or error-only) and do not reliably detect gradual capacity regression or ingress-induced token starvation during upgrades. This ticket introduces a Probe Harmonizer: a lightweight service + Terraform instrumentation that synthesizes composite signals (token throughput, per-request token delta, p50/p95 tail latency, 5xx rates) and emits harmonized SLO probes for VPC worker pools. Goals: 1) detect token throughput drift within 5% of baseline across 1m and 15m windows; 2) surface correlated latency+error anomalies tied to token queueing; 3) provide automated canary gating hooks for upgrades and a remediation playbook for on-call to follow. The work spans: IaC changes (Terraform module updates to inject probe sidecars and exporters), runtime metrics tagging (node, allocation, model-variant), a harmonizer service that computes composite SLOs and exposes health endpoints, dashboards and alerts, and integration into canary/rollout pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harmonizer service deployed to staging VPC with Terraform module toggles; 2) Composite SLOs (Effective Token Latency, Token Throughput Stability) visible in Observability with p50/p95 and per-node breakdown; 3) Alerting rule triggers on synthetic scenario causing throughput drop and links to runbook; 4) Canary gate rejects simulated capacity regression during upgrade; 5) Unit and e2e tests for telemetry enrichment and harmonizer logic added; 6) On-call runbook reviewed and approved by SREs
implementation_notes: Architecture: add small sidecar exporter to private workers that emits per-request token usage and enqueue delay metrics; extend existing Terraform module (module.vpc.worker_probe) to optionally enable sidecar and export port + certs. Harmonizer service (stateless) subscribes to metrics stream (Prometheus remote-write or central metrics aggregation) and computes rolling metrics: token_delta_per_request, token_rate_per_node, effective_token_latency = weighted(token_rate_zscore, p95_latency_norm). The harmonizer exposes /health/composite and /probe-metrics for the Console to consume. For upgrades, wire harmonizer into canary controller: canary passes only when composite SLOs are within configurable drift thresholds for at least 10 minutes. Rollout hooks will support soft-fail (warn) vs hard-fail modes. Terraform changes will include feature flag and new IAM roles (minimal).
testing_plan: Unit tests for harmonizer computation logic; local integration using a synthetic workload generator that can simulate token leaks and queueing; staging rollout with traffic shadowing; synthetic failover test to validate canary gating rejects the bad version; add PrometheusRule e2e test that fires alerts in CI when simulated thresholds are crossed; manual on-call drill to execute runbook steps
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: added exporter increases surface area and may slightly increase memory on worker; mitigate by implementing as opt-in via module toggle and defaulting to off for lighter footprints. Risk: false positives from composite metric during bursty workloads; mitigate by dynamic baselining and using z-score windows and requiring multi-window confirmation. Risk: IAM drift in Terraform; mitigate by least-privilege review and automated plan guardrails.
updates: 2026-03-01 - Created ticket. Drafted high-level design and identified required Terraform module changes.
2026-03-03 - PoC harmonizer logic completed (Python) for token_delta and p95 correlation. PoC notebook: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/harmonizer-poc (internal).

2026-03-05 - Terraform module prototype added under module.vpc.worker_probe in branch feat/probe-harmonizer (github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pulls/412). Requesting initial security review for new exporters.
2026-03-07 - Review feedback from SRE (Marcus Li): require opt-in for low-memory SKUs and add TLS mTLS between exporter and harmonizer. Added to implementation notes.

2026-03-10 - Integrated harmonizer /health/composite into canary controller prototype. Canary rejects simulated 7% sustained throughput regression in staging. Next: create dashboards and formal runbook.
notes_for_ops: Runbook snapshot: 1) Check harmonizer /metrics and /health/composite; 2) If alert fired, run `rbac/terraform plan` to confirm no recent IAM change, then `kubectl logs` for exporter on flagged nodes; 3) If throughput leak confirmed, rollback to previous canary using rollout controller `rdctl rollout rollback --canary <id>`; 4) Escalate to infra on-call if per-node token counters diverge >15%
rollback_plan: Enable canary hard-fail to stop rollout; revert Terraform module toggle to disable exporter; revert harmonizer deployment and restore previous canary policy. Documented in runbook and included as `rollback.sh` in infra repo.
